description.zh: 把平均数看作倒水齐平后的水位：总量守恒，水位 = 总量 ÷ 杯数。假设水可自由倒且可分。
description.en: The mean seen as the level after pouring until even: the total is conserved and level = total ÷ cups. Assumes water pours freely and is divisible.

label.zh: 同一个平均数的两种画法

reason.zh: 倒水齐平与条形图上的平均线是同一件事：高出的部分正好补足不足的部分。
reason.en: Pouring until level and the mean line on a bar chart are the same fact: what sticks out exactly fills what falls short.

title.zh: 平均数为什么是总数除以个数？
title.en: Why is the mean the total divided by the count?
